summary: 53-year-old man drowned while paddle boarding on Shaw Lake; no life preserver and the paddle-board recovery leash was not connected; body recovered July 30
responding_agency: Mineral County Search and Rescue; South Fork Fire Rescue; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Rio Grande National Forest
notes: Incident date 2024-07-29, body recovered 2024-07-30 per Mineral County Sheriff release; victim identity still being determined at time of release.
